data.body:
DESCOPE RATIONALE: The original bug framing ('dead YAML parser') was inaccurate. read-config.sh's YAML support is an intentionally retained migration-compat fallback documented in FLAT-CONFIG-MIGRATION.md, with active test coverage in tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh. The real defect was stale workflow-config.yaml references in agent-facing skill/prompt files.

FIX APPLIED (commit d550307632): replaced all active workflow-config.yaml refs with .claude/dso-config.conf in skills/prompts + claude-safe comments; labeled YAML support in read-config.sh docstring as legacy migration-compat; added skills-tree guard test (test_no_workflow_config_yaml_in_skills) to test-no-yaml-config-refs.sh.

YAML PARSER RETIREMENT DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: Removing YAML support would require (1) inverting the YAML assertions in tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh (98 tests pass with YAML behavior), (2) a deprecation-window decision for projects still on workflow-config.yaml, (3) updating FLAT-CONFIG-MIGRATION.md. This is a design decision that needs human approval — not an autonomous autofix.
